title: Example, Not Rote Instruction: He Imitates What He Sees
summary: A toddler imitates his parents far more than he obeys their commands. When he sees you praying, remembering Allah, and treating people with good character, he absorbs the religion as living behaviour, not a lesson. Be the curriculum yourself.
try_this: Today: Let your child see you in a moment of worship or good character, without commanding him to do anything.
reflection_prompts: What does your child imitate from you?
What example did you offer this week?
